config.blind_response_boundary: Root freeze precedes any joint-response processing; same GP15 cruise/labs. Leg1 exploration acknowledged.

estimand: Six matched-layer observed/predicted/depth-baseline pH means and errors
Unweighted-across-nonempty-fixed-layers bias, MAE and RMSE, always with coverage denominator
DeltaRMSE = fixed-model RMSE minus depth-baseline RMSE on identical layer support
Bottle-level residual distribution only secondary; no bottle-level p-value

station_resampling.scope: Conditional whole-station resampling only. Along-transect spatial dependence and non-probability sampling mean percentile intervals have no established nominal confidence coverage; analytical covariance and calibration parameter uncertainty are excluded.

pH_systematic_scenarios.meaning: Observed offsets are conditional corrections motivated by two positive GP15 CRM offsets, not known sample corrections. Training-reference offsets shift both model and depth baseline identically. All crossed scenarios use identical primary support; no scenario is a confidence bound or truth.

REE_reference_repeatability.source_locator: GP15 Leg2 REE intercalibration PDF8 Table2 andPDF9 Table3; maximum among listed reference-water RSDs for each of the four elements
REE_reference_repeatability.vectors: All16 combinations of +/-1 reported RSD; each element factor is common to all bottles within a case
REE_reference_repeatability.interpretation: Reference-repeatability-motivated conditional box only. Not measured sample-specific errors, a95%confidence interval, a full error covariance, or a conservative true bound. Common element shifts represent coherent systematic directions that do not diminish with sample count. All16vectors and all9pHscenarios are retained; no best-scenario selection. These are16 sampled corners only; there is no proof of extrema or uniform robustness over the continuous error box, especially for nonlinear model-minus-baseline RMSE.

robustness.leave_one_station_out: Both legs primary; all six layers retained, no aggregate if original support lost; full output
robustness.sixteen_corner_scope: Only enumerated corners, no uniform continuous-box robustness claim

stopping_rules: Stop before responses if input/source SHA or fixed model identity fails, or duplicate/ambiguous source identity cannot be resolved.
Preserve six layers even when empty or poorly supported; an entire200–800m domain statement requires all six layers to meet the prespecified station rule.

Give conditional station-resampling percentile intervals only with at least6 station labels and at least90% bootstrap draws covering all originally nonempty layers. Otherwise report point estimates/support only.
No scalar threshold makes the candidate paper-eligible. Evaluate magnitude against declared source-method scales and original training span without treating either as a universal acceptance bound.
If only an acknowledged generic caveat or a result driven by one station remains, close or narrow the claim rather than tune elements, coefficients, exclusions or bins.

Leg1 is exploration-exposed; Leg2 is a prospective response check only if root's exposure ledger verifies the freeze preceded response access. Shared cruise/lab precludes claiming independent-laboratory replication.
A regional transfer result cannot alone refute the original global-mean relation, the pH-complexation mechanism, or all paleo-carbonate applications.

limitations: Same GP15 cruise and laboratories; no independent-study validation source IDs.
Leg2 is a prospectively unexamined joint-response station block; source QA examined identity/flags/depth and published methods/reference waters only.
Leg1 and original calibration were exploration-exposed; no model tuning or element selection follows any GP15 response.
Spatially correlated nonprobability station sampling has no proven nominal resampling confidence coverage.
